headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.5
summary: Launching Minecraft on 32-bit devices works again after the library-extraction rework, and the launcher now warns when the 32-bit build runs on a 64-bit-capable device.

items.text: 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) devices can launch Minecraft again: library preparation no longer aborts when the arm64-only native helper is unavailable.
On 32-bit devices the launcher now falls back to the game's own libraries, and bundled arm64-only libraries no longer fail the whole launch.
When the armeabi-v7a build is installed on a 64-bit-capable device, a warning dialog now suggests downloading the arm64-v8a build with a direct link to the latest release.
